description: Lofts between two or more sketch profiles in order, optionally following guide curves: a boss adds material, a cut removes it. Checked: the feature exists as a loft, rebuilds without error, the part has a solid body, and its volume grew (boss) or shrank (cut). Otherwise the loft is deleted and the part is as it was (rolled back); the sketches stay. Busy with user_editing while the user is editing a sketch or has a command open. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

document.description: The part: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

profiles.description: The profiles, in the order the loft passes through them: at least two sketches, by name or reference, each a closed profile on its own plane.

guides.description: Guide curves the loft follows between its profiles: sketches, by name or reference, each touching every profile.

mode.description: boss (adds material) or cut (removes it). Default boss.

merge.description: For a boss: merge it with the bodies it touches. Default true. Not for a cut.
